IMPORT.TITLE: Import Estimates
IMPORT.SKIP_DUPLICATES_DESC: Estimates whose number already exists are skipped. Turn this off to report them as errors instead.
IMPORT.SKIP_DUPLICATE_LINES_DESC: Within an estimate, a line identical to an earlier one (same item, quantity, price, discount and description) is skipped.
IMPORT.AUTO_NUMBER_DESC: Estimate numbers are generated from your numbering settings. Any estimate numbers in the file are ignored.
IMPORT.TIP_ROWS: Each row of the file is one estimate line. Rows with the same estimate number are imported as one estimate.
IMPORT.TIP_MATCH: Customers and items must already exist. Customers are matched by name; items by barcode first, then SKU, then name, and must be available in this branch. An estimate with an unknown customer or unavailable item is reported as an error.
IMPORT.TIP_EXPIRY: The expiry date defaults to the estimate date when left empty. Estimate numbers that already exist are skipped, or reported as errors when Skip duplicate estimates is off.
